messages:
Maria Chen: Quick heads-up — we need to reforecast Q2 OKRs. After last week's infra run, shipping multimodal-embeddings by EOW looks risky. Proposal: de-scope multimodal embeddings from Q2 scope and reallocate ~40% of eng to 'inference-cost-optimizer' and keep ~60% on 'dedicated-scaling-sla'. Thoughts? @Ajay @Katie

Ajay Patel: can we push multimodal to Q3? what's the impact on committed revenue targets?

Katie H.: Depends on sales commitments. @Sam Biz, any active deals hinging on multimodal?

Sam Biz: One pilot with RetailX expects embeddings; won't block renewal but would accelerate expansion. They can accept a Q3 delivery if we provide an interim roadmap + sandbox.

Leo Ramos: From eng POV we need the extra cycles to finish the KV cache refactor. Without that, 95th perc latency SLOs risk regressing. +1 to reallocate.

Maria Chen: ok — plan suggestion: formally change OKRs: remove 'multimodal GA' from Q2, add 'cost-optimizer P0' with success criteria: 15% per-token cost reduction on chat workloads and 95th perc latency <= +5% regression. Also add a canary validation step.

Ajay Patel: can we promise 15% without degrading tail latency? need a validation run and a clear rollback.

Katie H.: Add to launch criteria: must be validated across 3 prod-like workloads with perf regression <5% and cost reduction >=12% (so engineering has margin). Also require a retrospective on any failed canaries.

Maria Chen: drafting OKR PR now. I'll include rollout plan + customer comms. @deploy-bot please create a tracker ticket for the OKR change and resource shift.

deploy-bot: created issue RDW-2046 in roadmap tracker — https://redwood/rdw/2046 (labels: okr-change, reforecast, q2-scope).

Sam Biz: I'll send a one-pager to RetailX with the adjusted timeline and invite them to a sandbox. They were fine with a Q3 GA as long as we surface the plan.

Leo Ramos: estimate note: shifting 40% of the team to cost-optimizer moves dedicated-scaling-sla work out to mid-Q3. Need to flag infra for capacity planning.

Maria Chen: decision summary: hold multimodal -> Q3, allocate resources to cost-optimizer, update OKRs and success criteria as discussed. Approvals needed by EOD from @Ajay and @Katie to finalize PR.

Ajay Patel: approved.

Katie H.: approved. :thumbsup:

Maria Chen: thanks team — I'll merge the OKR PR and kick off comms.
